objective: forward DXVK's first logical-device descriptor and sampler bootstrap calls through the glibc-to-Bionic bridge without transmitting pointers or fabricating Vulkan handles

wire.representation: canonical little-endian scalar records and typed 64-bit bridge object IDs only
wire.native_reconstruction: the Bionic service creates local Vulkan bindings, binding flags, pool sizes, set-layout arrays, sampler structs, image infos, writes, and pNext links

supported_shape.layout: sampler bindings, no immutable samplers, and the exact binding-flags pNext used by DXVK's legacy sampler heap
supported_shape.allocation: one bounded RPC may allocate up to 16 real native descriptor sets
supported_shape.update: one bounded RPC may carry up to 32 sampler-only writes and 128 sampler IDs
supported_shape.destroy: real native sampler, pool, and layout destruction with pool-owned set invalidation

fail_closed: unsupported descriptor types, flags, or malformed counts

verification.canonical_codec: round trips every new variable and fixed record and rejects corrupted reserved bytes
verification.cross_process_fake_driver: observed the exact constructor and destruction order, exact requested booleans/counts/enums/floats, native non-dummy handles, and sampler descriptor contents

first_remaining_call.derivation: after the sampler pool creates its default sampler, DxvkObjects constructs DxvkPipelineManager; its eager null-fragment library builds an empty descriptor-set layout (covered by this create codec) and then creates a pipeline layout

reuse: Reused E045's loader-private/local-pointer rule and E046's fixed-width object-RPC ownership pattern. The required deja search returned no prior descriptor-bootstrap implementation.
scope: Host transport and native fake-driver proof only; no Android deployment, Turnip execution, DXVK adapter acceptance, pipeline creation, game frame, or FPS claim
